findings.severity: high: S10's switch is not done (does not block HD_PUBLIC=1: the public build has one house)
findings.what: the house switch is painted as a cut to black and a fade-in from black, not a dissolve from one house to the other. Every switch, both directions, full and reduced motion, 1280 and 400: the stage's mean brightness falls from ~190-200 to 24-48 and climbs back. Cause in site/web/src/engine/gl.ts: ensureTargets() drops both targets (prev and next) whenever the compose width changes, and the Nordic house composes at 1920 (lo on a phone) while the warm-modern one composes at 2720 (native): the 'prev' of the dissolve is a new, empty texture. The e2e checks the page's timestamps and boxes only; the S10 evidence 'half-way' screenshot shows the end state
findings.fix: keep the previous composite when the width changes (allocate the new pair and copy, or let the display pass sample a prev of another size; drop the old one after the dissolve); an e2e that reads painted pixels mid-switch (CDP screencast, or preserveDrawingBuffer under a test flag) and fails on a dip below min(start, end)

findings.what: the invoice job is idempotent only when its runs do not overlap: two concurrent runs issue two invoices (Queues deliver at least once); a failure between the provider call and the audit_log insert makes the retry issue a second one. audit_log has no unique key; the mock dedupes per call and hides it
findings.fix: claim before issuing: a table invoices(order_id PRIMARY KEY, state, provider_invoice_id) and INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; only the claimant calls the provider, with the order id as the provider's idempotency key; a claim without a result is resolved by asking the provider, not by issuing again; vitest for concurrency and for the crash

findings.what: production falls back to mocks that pretend: INVOICE_PROVIDER unset or 'mock' records MOCK-INV-<order> as order.invoiced (a real provider configured later skips the order); SUPPLIER_PROVIDER unset, 'mock' or mistyped ('CJ') marks a paid order sent_to_supplier ('בהכנה' for the customer) with nothing ordered. Payments have a production guard; invoices and suppliers do not
findings.fix: refuse a mock invoice provider and a mock supplier when ENVIRONMENT=production (retry, not success), match provider ids exactly from an allow-list, fail the deploy check on an unknown value; vitest

findings.what: the invoice guard is a deny-list (pending_payment, payment_failed): a canceled or refunded order that was never paid (paid_at NULL) is invoiced. No path enqueues such a job today
findings.fix: require paid_at IS NOT NULL and an allow-list of statuses

findings.what: with INVOICE_PROVIDER=UNDECIDED (the production config) the invoice message throws inside the queue loop; the handler rejects, and the messages after it in the batch (a submit-order too) are neither acked nor retried in that attempt, and spend retries toward the DLQ
findings.fix: catch per message; an unbuilt provider returns retry (or a dead-letter with a reason) for its own message only

findings.what: with PAYMENT_PROVIDER=grow outside production, /api/webhooks/payment/mock is still live: a valid HMAC pays a pending mock order
findings.fix: accept a webhook only for the configured provider (the path's provider must equal env.PAYMENT_PROVIDER)

findings.what: 'החדר שלך' picks the wheel option by product, not by the variant bought, and always draws the Nordic living room: a wine-red bouclé cushion is drawn white; set B bought in the warm-modern house shows the Nordic room with the white muslin throw instead of Pecan; the caption says 'כפי שהרכבת אותו'. S10 widened it: the warm-modern pieces are also on the Nordic wheel
findings.fix: draw a layer only when the bought variant is the rendered one, in the house the order came from; otherwise omit the figure or caption it as an illustration of the product's place
